scope: Manual review of final new native poses, real 40-pose GPU 4x atlas, actual UI preview, and sampled full action cycle; technical tests are independent
observations: Final down/left/right/up new poses retain accepted native helmet, armor palette, anatomical left wrist tool and both support feet.
Rejected initial whole-arm left-shoulder translation was replaced by explicit upper-arm/forearm segmentation; final shoulder stays with torso.
Down-facing extension has individually authored elbow connection; no visible floating fragment or open shoulder seam in final contact and actual GPU sheets.
Idle is a restrained one-pixel upper-body motion; collect is compact lowering/forearm extension, not a new large limb rotation.
Actual atlas reads every one of 40 poses; 1x and 4x GPU equality separately measured. Manual visual review does not replace connectivity and source-hash checks.
One-second preview time samples preserve idle 2FPS, walk 8FPS, collect 6FPS followed by idle; collect resource remains non-looping.
